event.unit: one accepted observation and its one free greedy act; a lesson at that event belongs to the same event
event.clock: the declared slot schedule supplies physical time only; no clock value, slot number or phase enters any observation

observations.drive: coordinate 0 at 1.0 on every drive and cue event
observations.cue: one cue coordinate at 1.0 on the first event of a bout, two rows per cue

teaching.label: the cued action at a cue event; afterwards the opposite of the row's own last executed action

arms.every: Learner.step on the live stimulus before every free act
arms.mismatch: free act first; Learner.step on the pre-act stimulus for the rows whose act differed from the label

window.probe: complete checkpoint after the lead act and before the next act; every control forks it

disturbances.pause_checkpoint: pause2 saves after its first pause event; a loaded twin continues beside the original

cadence.host_load: one spinning process per logical CPU during the paced_regular_load run

recipes.note: selected changes one gene against the compose default: working_memory_decay 0.1 instead of 0.2; the learning law is the composed finite teaching law with eta 0.5, momentum 0.9, nudged_steps 12; the compose default is the control recipe and runs on every founder
recipes.development: chosen on development seeds 0-5 over decays 0.0/0.1/0.2, amplitudes 1.0/3.0 and rates default/0.05n/0.02n/0.005n at 12 and 24 bouts; see results/development-*.json

policy.refusal: a refused act is a missed action: no action, no trace update, the event is consumed, the life continues
policy.lesson_refusal: a refused lesson is charged and skipped
policy.forks: controls load the probe checkpoint; no fork installs state into the live life
policy.denominator: every planned founder stays in the denominator; refused and unrun events are wrong
policy.selection: no default change, mechanism or acceptance horizon is claimed

caps.note: a run past the cap writes its completed founders and exits 3
